meta: Role: Backend Engineer · Level: Junior · Manager: Priya Menon · Buddy: Daniel Wong
scenes.say: Welcome to Northwind Labs, Alex. Here is your first day in one story: the codebase you own, and how a single login moves through it.

scenes.title: Why we exist
points: Small enough to run from a phone
When in doubt, choose the simpler option
say: Simple enough that a two-person team can run it from a phone.
So when in doubt, choose the simpler option.

scenes.title: What you own
points: The API and data layer of CTMS
Code review within one working day
say: You own the API and data layer of CTMS, a cinema ticketing app.
That means controllers, services, D A O queries and models.
Plus the tests for whatever you ship.
And you review teammates' pull requests within one working day.

scenes.title: The request arrives
scenes.point: doPost() reads the email and password
scenes.say: A customer submits the login form. It lands in LoginServlet, where doPost reads the email and password.

scenes.title: The servlet hands off
scenes.point: Business logic lives in the service, not the servlet
scenes.say: The servlet hands off to AccountService, which checks both the employee and customer records. Business logic lives here.

scenes.title: One prepared query
scenes.say: The service calls CustomerDAO, which runs one prepared query. Prepared statements keep it safe from SQL injection.

scenes.title: Down to the database
scenes.point: A new JDBC connection each time. No pool, so close what you open
scenes.say: ConnectionDB opens a JDBC connection to PostgreSQL. There is no pool, so always close what you open.

scenes.title: The answer comes back
scenes.point: Password checked, role returned, user saved in the session
scenes.say: The row becomes a Customer, AccountService checks the password and returns a role, and the servlet saves the user in the session.

scenes.title: The filter guards the door
scenes.point: Every employee page checks session and role first
scenes.say: AuthFilter now checks that session and role before any employee page loads. Then the browser lands on the right dashboard.

scenes.title: Before you touch anything
points: No automated tests yet: yours sets the standard
say: Three things before you touch anything. Database credentials are hardcoded, so ask Daniel for the dev ones.
And there are no automated tests yet: your first one sets the standard.

scenes.title: Your first week
points: Get the app running, walk the code tour
Quick win: fix the genere typo in Movie
say: Get the app running and walk the code tour.
Your quick win is fixing the misspelled genere field in the Movie model.
Then refactor MovieDAO, with Daniel reviewing.
On day five, check in with Priya.

scenes.title: Who to ask
points: IT Help · accounts, on day one
say: Daniel is your buddy, for day-to-day code questions.
Priya is your manager, for expectations and thirty-day goals.
IT handles your accounts, so email them on day one. Not sure why we chose Ant or Supabase? The pack says unknown, so ask Daniel. Welcome aboard, Alex.
